description: A Boolean valuation models the shared clause set of a finite Horn theory exactly when its true set satisfies every rule.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.theory_bridge.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α))
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Models v (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.clauseSet Γ) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Γ {p | v p = true}
